title: Claude Opus 4.5 and Nano Banana Pro joined the lineup
summary:
New Claude and image models arrived while the APIs around them got better at accepting real-world requests and preserving their responses.

`claude-large` now selects Claude Opus 4.5, while `claude` selects Sonnet 4.5 and `claude-fast` selects Haiku 4.5. On the image side, `nanobanana-pro` added Gemini 3 Pro Image, then gained output selection up to 4K, closer aspect-ratio matching, and a 2048-pixel default side length.

Image URLs now work in Vertex AI vision requests, and parsing preserves token limits and other OpenAI-compatible options instead of silently dropping them. Chat validation accepts provider-specific finish reasons and missing assistant content; content-part arrays also work beyond user messages, including document parts and Anthropic cache controls. Streaming errors retain upstream HTTP statuses, and newer Azure OpenAI models accept `max_tokens`.

Enter now tracks a copy of each response, leaving streaming output available to its caller, and handles responses without extractable model usage. It also caches meter balances for five minutes and updates the cached balance after billable requests, reducing balance-check calls. Model listings now show prices in Pollen and use consistent specialization metadata.

The new `DELETE /delete/prompt/:prompt` endpoint invalidates an image cache entry using its original prompt and query parameters. Its JSON response reports the result of each deletion attempt.
